resources.string: Poker Dice is played with 5 special dice featuring playing card suits (9, 10, Jack, Queen, King, Ace) instead of numbers. Players roll the dice and try to form the best poker hand possible. Each player typically gets up to 3 rolls per turn, choosing which dice to keep and which to re-roll. After the final roll, the player with the highest-ranking poker hand wins the round. Common hands include pairs, three/four of a kind, full house, and five of a kind.

This application was developed as part of the Mobile Devices Programming (PDM) course at Instituto Superior de Engenharia de Lisboa (ISEL), for the Computer Engineering and Computers degree (LEIC). Developed during the 2025/2026 Winter Semester by Group 28, class 52D:
